docs/theme-tokens.md, Phase 2 palette decisions: authored readability adjustments to the cited Coda 1 families, not native historical values.

charcoal.$description: A slightly lighter, warmer interpretation of Coda 1 charcoal.

copper.$description: Lift Coda 1 keyword copper for small modern editor text.

olive.$description: Softer, lighter olive; keep strings distinct from blue literals.

blue.$description: Lift and soften Coda 1 dusty-blue numbers, not One Dark cyan.

terracotta.$description: Lift Coda 1 red-orange functions while retaining their warm hue rather than the later mauve.

lavender.$description: Subdued lavender variables inspired by Coda 1 Ruby/PHP and later ports; a modern cross-language judgment.

honey.$description: Soften native honey tags/classes without changing their family.

orange.$description: Lighter orange attributes/properties; separate from lavender variables.

purple.$description: Lift native regex purple without turning regex into cyan or strings into purple.

light-purple.$description: Lighter purple escapes and regex character classes.

comment.$description: Readable quiet warm gray in place of native #666666; kept below primary text.

classic-comment.$description: Explicit Classic readability exception: lift native #666666, retaining quieter comments than flagship.

error.$description: Visible red feedback for both restored variants; not inferred from native SGML or CDATA rows.
